correctness.rationale: From the actual paper's canonical-model separation (distinct literal-state representation sets separate exact truthmakers) and closure equivalence, a normal-form disjunction with state-representation sets A_i has closed representations exactly {union_{i in I} A_i: nonempty I}; this is a nonempty union-closed family on the canonical literal universe C_n. Conversely choose a conjunction for each A in any such union-closed family, proving surjectivity; canonical-model exact verification and separation prove injectivity modulo exact equivalence, not merely syntactic equality. At modal degree 0 the universe contains 2q signed propositional literals. New signed modal literals correspond to nonempty canonical state-description sets at degree 0, giving R1=2q+2(2^(2q)-1); higher levels add 2(2^R_n - 2^R_(n-1)). Recomputed R0=2 and R1=8 and R2=512 for q=1, and R1=34 for q=2. Thus R_n<=12 exactly for n=0,q<=6 and n=1,q=1 among q>=1. The 12-element Frankl theorem gives a majority member of any union-closed family on that ambient universe; its computer-assisted exhaustive proof is imported, not reproduced. Boundary specifies uniform implication via R_n only, not a counterexample to Frankl outside those fragments.
